'''May 2000 Modesto tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Gauntlet, Modesto, CA on 13 May 2000. [[Ohmy Fasudhani]] won it. It is known from Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d742">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-14-modesto-ca-5-13d742/ modesto-ca-5-13], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 14 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-14-modesto-ca-5-13d742/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 May 2000
* '''Site:''' The Gauntlet, Modesto, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Ohmy Fasudhani]]
